the datasheet's NOMINAL figures hit to the clock. A 50-clock high gives 417 ns
of low, 7 % under the nominal tLOW, and the receiver's margin is better spent
matching the datasheet than maximising one side of it.
A 0 cell is low for the WHOLE 1.25 us
rather than carrying a 0.4 us high
first - a deliberate simplification, measured and reported rather than left
implied: the strip samples at about 2/3 into the cell, so a line low
throughout is unambiguously a 0, and shaping the 0 as well would cost a second
conditional in a cell that has none to spare.
There is no checksum and no acknowledge.
Nothing on the wire says the
frame arrived. The whole of the protocol's error detection is the reset.
